en.headline: Elderly man dies after Sai Ying Pun flat fire
en.dek: A man in his 70s died in hospital after firefighters pulled him unconscious from a burning flat at Hang Fai Building on Pok Fu Lam Road on Monday night.
body: Firefighters extinguished a blaze at Hang Fai Building on Pok Fu Lam Road in Sai Ying Pun around 9:54pm on Monday after arriving within minutes of the report. A man in his 70s was found unconscious inside the flat and taken to Queen Mary Hospital, where he later died.

The Fire Services Department said the fire originated in the kitchen and was suspected to have been caused by cooking. There were no suspicious circumstances, and about 60 residents were evacuated from the building.
A section of Pok Fu Lam Road was closed during the incident, and several bus routes were diverted. The cause of death is under investigation.

zh.headline: 西營盤恆輝大廈火警 七旬男子送院不治
zh.dek: 周一晚上薄扶林道恆輝大廈單位起火，消防員救出一名七十多歲昏迷男子，送瑪麗醫院後證實不治。
body: 消防處表示，周一晚上八時五十七分接報，薄扶林道22至32號恆輝大廈一單位起火冒煙，人員四分鐘內到達，動用一條喉及一隊煙帽隊灌救，火勢於晚上九時五十四分大致救熄。
消防人員在起火單位救出一名昏迷的七十多歲男子，即場急救後送瑪麗醫院，其後證實不治。經調查，火警源頭為單位廚房，懷疑因煮食引起，沒有可疑。約六十名住客疏散。
事發期間薄扶林道一段全封，多條巴士線改道。警方及消防正調查死因。
